1.t: Say: "I seek refuge with (Allâh), the Lord of the daybreak,

2.t: "From the evil of what He has created,

3.t: "And from the evil of the darkening (night) as it comes with its darkness; (or the moon as it sets or goes away),

4.t: "And from the evil of those who practise witchcraft when they blow in the knots,

5.t: "And from the evil of the envier when he envies."
